Reading: Every row carries a participant, a theme, a sub-theme, a code, a verbatim quote and a transcript line number.
All 69 new codes fit inside the existing 22 themes. The theme structure has held for the first time.
P001 to P017 complete. P011 is on EchoVision and needs a visible device split in any pooled count.

Item: Answers as if the user can see
Reading: The glasses forget that I am not sighted. Told out loud that the user cannot see, it apologises and continues in the same terms.
Left, right, and a distance in feet. Three participants ask for the identical repair, one of them quoting a competing app that already does it.

Item: Coaching the user cannot act on
Reading: Told to lay a curved package flat. Accurate advice, impossible instruction, and the user reads the failure as her own.
Peripheral-only vision pulls the head up. The camera captured trees instead of the shop sign. The device assumes a normative sightline.
Stated four times by one participant. She does not know how to know if it is incorrect, and assumes it is correct.

Item: Says a thing is absent when present
Reading: A new failure class. It leaves no wrong fact behind to catch later, and absence is what the user cannot check.
A flashing hospital monitor and a blinking washer light. The most urgent thing in the room is what a still frame cannot carry.
The only routine verification method in seventeen interviews. It works because the cane returns ground truth on the exact class of claim the device is worst at.
Asks about food already identified by touch, to gauge trust. Bounded to tasks where the device adds nothing.
Better than what I have had in the past. An unknown error rate is acceptable because the comparison is having nothing.
A daily user of nine months learns mid-interview that it runs a general AI. My ear does not go to the AI part.
Happy with what it does, so never asks what else it does. Satisfaction is suppressing demand.

Item: Did not know it could do that
Reading: Still the largest single non-use reason across the corpus.
The participant furthest from the community groups is the one who did not know the device category. Awareness tracks membership more closely than tenure.
Now present in nine of seventeen sessions. A finding about user knowledge and a standing threat to self-report validity.
Reading an ingredient label was not a task performed badly. It was not in her world. No usage log can show this.
Named as the largest barrier to outdoor use by one participant, ahead of every capability limit in the study.
Scanning a product exceeds the one minute retail loss prevention watches for. Task use confined to one familiar shop.
I am using the Meta Glasses, said to staff before scanning anything. Unpaid work, performed to avoid suspicion.
Stopped by a Broadway usher. The wearer cannot see the indicator that would settle the challenge.
Naming each relative by title on entering a room is obligatory. Failing to recognise reads as rudeness.
Did not carry a cane until her thirties. Judged text-to-speech users as lazy before his own vision changed.
Raised independently by all three. One has entered the wrong car. One asked it to watch for a white car and was refused.
Currently solved by arriving 45 minutes early, or tapping a cane against strangers’ feet.
One step at a time while the hands are busy. Three participants ask for it, one routes through ChatGPT to get it.
Finding waste, vomit and a sore on a dog. Frequent, unglamorous, and one participant assumes it is banned.
Name the noise and place it. The one request in the set that has nothing to do with the camera.
Step aerobics choreography called out when the instructor does not cue verbally.
Draw a circle around the person I am looking for. The first request in the study that audio output cannot satisfy.
Single source. Bending or looking down stops the session and resets it. Needs a direct check in the observation phase.

Item: Same words route to the wrong capability
Reading: A colour question returns a room description. Read as operator error by the user, so it never reaches support.
Echoing and tunnel-like, and it masks natural hearing. First report of audio character as the reason live mode stays off.
Proposes calls and messages nobody asked for. Live mode switches itself on and costs a power cycle.
Interrupts the single most-used feature in this participant group, and the setting is not findable.
Named as the favourite property of the device. Half of what makes it work for these users has nothing to do with the camera.

Item: Refuses to read on policy grounds
Reading: Medication dates and payment cards. Every participant supplies a liability rationale unprompted and accepts it.

Item: Attributes a limit to a rule
Reading: Compliance absorbed as a capability limit, which means it never reaches anyone as a complaint.
A prompt that worked stops working. Card reading disappears. One participant has stopped tracking capabilities entirely.
Comfortable with the dosage instructions read aloud, unwilling to have her name on the bottle captured.
Chose the AI over a human volunteer to keep a relative’s medical data out of a stranger’s view.
Just me, the glasses and my phone, and not the rest of the world. Consent is resting on a mistaken model of the system.
The privacy risk named is the spoken output rather than the captured image.
